cards.claim: Florence Bagnard has been appointed as the new Prefect of Lozère.
cards.quote: **MENDE, LOZÈRE -** In a milestone moment for French politics, Florence Bagnard has been appointed as the new Prefect of Lozère, becoming the first woman to hold the esteemed position in the region's history. The 45-year-old politician, known for her tireless advocacy on rural development and environmental issues, was officially sworn in yesterday at a ceremony attended by local dignitaries and officials from the Ministry of the Interior. "I am deeply honored to take on this role and serve the people of Lozère," Bagnard said in an exclusive interview with our newspaper. "As a native of this region, I understand the unique challenges we face, and I am committed to working tirelessly to promote economic growth, improve public services, and protect our natural heritage." Bagnard's appointment has been widely welcomed by local residents, who see her as a breath of fresh air in the region's politics. "Florence has always been a champion of our community," said Pierre Roussel, mayor of the nearby town of Marvejols. "Her dedication to our region's development is unmatched, and we have no doubt she will excel in this new role." As Prefect of Lozère, Bagnard will be responsible for overseeing the region's administrative services, ensuring public safety, and implementing national policies at the local level.

raw_card.claim: Florence Bagnard currently holds the position of conseiller municipal de Givry.
